remediations.detail: Caller AbortSignal reaches answer and deliverable providers, legal and safety-reference retrieval, accident cases, KMA, Work24, KOSHA education, official-reference checks, and KOSHA OpenAPI. OpenAI and Anthropic receive request signals. Vertex uses an authenticated REST adapter whose underlying fetch observes the same caller signal. Abort errors bypass fallback and retry work.

Document export concurrency uses an atomic Upstash sorted-set lease shared by instances. Production fails closed when distributed concurrency is absent or unavailable; local development retains the existing instance guard.

REST, ranked RPC, and vector RPC JSON bodies remain inside the five-second request deadline and enforce a one MiB streamed byte limit. Caller abort, fallback behavior, and malformed JSON failure semantics are covered.

deployment.evidenceBoundary: Production marker proves deployment of the tested product commit; cancellation behavior is proven by source-level JSON, SSE, provider, and enrichment regression tests without invoking live providers.
